final_message:
I've drafted the September 2026 monthly trends write-up for Bluebird Bakery. It's still marked DRAFT for the reviewer.

**Files** (in `evals/runs/v6-run-20261014/g_bb_no_ttm/skill_output/`):
- `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.md`: the report, with 8 commentary bullets in section 1.
- `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.json`: the source for every figure in the report.

**Data quality: 1 mismatch.** In March 2026, the "Total for Professional Services" row says 2,225, but the accounts under it add up to 2,200 (a 25 difference). The report uses 2,200, and the reviewer needs to decide which is right. The script also had to fill gaps in the sheet's structure in two places. "Total Delivery" has no section heading, so it was grouped from the two lines above it, which add up to it. "Charitable Donations" has no values and no total row, so it was counted as zero. The other cross-checks passed: gross profit, net income, the balance sheet balancing, and the balance-sheet subtotals. September isn't flagged as a partial month.

**Year-over-year and trailing-twelve-month (TTM) comparisons aren't possible:** the export covers only 9 months (Jan–Sep 2026). The commentary says this.

**Most important points:**
- **Revenue:** 81,300, up 17.7% on August (69,050) and 17.3% above the prior 6-month average. Of that, 12,000 is a new stream, Wholesale Accounts, which was zero for the prior 6 months. Pastry Sales has fallen about 2% every month since April.
- **Gross margin:** 65.3%, up 5.7 points on August and the highest of the 9 months.
- **Operating expenses:** 31,570, up 21.0%, mostly because Wages & Salaries rose 5,000 to 21,000 after payroll had been flat. Whether this is a one-month item or a new level is for the reviewer to confirm.
- **Cash:** the bank balance is 37,600, down 1,800 on August and down 10,800 from six months earlier. Equity fell from 54,660 to 44,940 even though the bakery made a profit every month. I've put this to the reviewer as a question (owner draws?) rather than guessing the cause.

**Accounts that didn't match any category (grouped as Other Opex):** Instagram Ads, Mystery Shopper Program and Supplier Rebates (a credit of 250). Mystery Shopper went from 0 to 400 this month, but it isn't new: it was also 400 in March and June. The commentary says this.

The report also flags that Gift Cards revenue was negative in March 2026 (-300), probably refunds or credits. I left it out of the commentary because it doesn't affect September, but it's in the flags list for the reviewer.
